pr_title: Hides `config set` from cli history for sensitive directives
pr_body:
Fixes #7081.

Hides `CONFIG SET requirepass/masterauth/masteruser`.

The next command that needs to be hidden should trigger a refactoring of the "dangerous" conditional logic to use some sort of stack struct with the hidden commands perhaps.
pr_comments: Thanks @madolson - I actually feel this is the right time to handle all sensitive commands in a saner way because that `if` statement is giving me the hibbiejibbies. #HelpNeeded :)
one idea is to try to rely on the `skip_slowlog` command flag. but we'll have to add an exception for EXEC, and also it seems it doesn't cover CONFIG (which is maybe something we need to solve too?)
please have a look at #7360, hides password from slowlog.

issue_context.title: Enhancement Request: Remove config set requirepass from Redis-cli log
comments: @IAmATeaPot418 While at it, I believe `CONFIG SET masterauth` and `CONFIG SET masteruser` should be masked as well.
@yossigo @itamarhaber - What about Migrate too now that we are on the subject ;) ?

review_comments: We could also auth with the hello command.
